acceptance_expectations.description: The report answers whether logistic regression accuracy is greater than or equal to baseline accuracy plus 5 percentage points. A negative finding satisfies the obligation to test and report; attaining the target is not presumed.
Only attached data are used, no external data or downloads are introduced, id is excluded from features, and preprocessing is learned only from training data.
Training uses train.csv, and predictions.csv contains exactly id,label with one binary label for each of the 600 test IDs in the original test order and no duplicates.

The report includes conclusion, limitations, exact preprocessing, parameters and split, clearly identifies validation measurements and blind predictions, and makes no unsupported test-accuracy claim. Permission for a seeded stratified split is preserved without selecting a split here.

constraints.text: predictions.csv must contain exactly id,label for all test IDs, in test order, without duplicates.
Learn preprocessing only from training data.
A seeded stratified train/validation split is permitted for the comparison because test labels are unavailable.
Distinguish validation measurements from blind test predictions; never invent test accuracy.
Document the exact preprocessing, parameters and split.

deliverables.description: Blind predictions for all 600 test.csv rows, with exactly id,label in test order and no duplicate IDs.
deliverables.name: predictions.csv

deliverables.description: Report the logistic regression and 1-nearest-neighbour comparison, the absolute accuracy difference and whether it reaches at least 5 percentage points, conclusion, limitations, and exact preprocessing, parameters and split. Distinguish validation measurements from blind test predictions.
deliverables.name: Comparison and limitations report

evidence_obligations.description: Provide the measured comparison accuracies, their evaluation context, the absolute difference in percentage points, and the supported conclusion against the at-least-5-percentage-point target.
Provide data provenance, the feature list excluding id, and preprocessing provenance showing that learned preprocessing uses training data only and that external data and downloads were excluded.

Provide evidence of training on train.csv and artifact checks establishing the exact id,label columns, 600 predictions, binary labels, complete test-ID coverage, original test order and absence of duplicates.

Provide the report documenting exact preprocessing, parameters and split, including the seed and stratification if the permitted split is used, with conclusion and limitations. Identify validation results separately from blind test predictions and acknowledge unavailable test labels.

in_scope.text: Compare logistic regression with a 1-nearest-neighbour baseline, train on train.csv, produce test.csv predictions in predictions.csv, and report the conclusion and limitations.

mandatory_requirements.text: Compare logistic regression with the requested 1-nearest-neighbour baseline and determine whether its accuracy is at least 5 percentage points higher. Report the conclusion whether or not the target is achieved.
Use only attached data, exclude external data and downloads, exclude id from features, and learn preprocessing only from training data.

Train on train.csv and write predictions for all 600 unlabelled test.csv rows to predictions.csv with exactly the columns id,label, preserving test order and containing no duplicate IDs; predicted labels must be 0 or 1.

Report the conclusion and limitations, document exact preprocessing, parameters and split, distinguish validation measurements from blind test predictions, and never invent test accuracy. A seeded stratified train/validation split is permitted because test labels are unavailable.

objective.text: Determine whether logistic regression beats a 1-nearest-neighbour baseline by at least 5 percentage points of accuracy using only the attached data; train on train.csv, produce predictions.csv for test.csv, and report the conclusion and limitations.

out_of_scope.text: External data and downloads are excluded.
The opaque row identifier id is not a feature.

target_metrics.target_text: Test whether logistic regression beats the baseline by at least 5 points accuracy.
